headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points as broad-based sell-off wiped out ₹6 lakh crore

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian stock markets are shut today, November 24, 2026, on account of the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday.
In the previous session on November 23, Dalal Street suffered a severe broad-based sell-off.
Metal and banking sectors faced heavy selling pressure during the last trading session.
Concerns surrounding falling US stock market futures after a monster rally impacted overall sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex plunged 1,484 points while Nifty dropped below the 25,400 mark on November 23.
Investors lost over ₹6 lakh crore in wealth during the sharp market crash in the last session.
IT stocks managed to outshine the broader market despite the heavy indices drop.
Tracxn report highlighted that India's AI funding nearly doubled to $1.6 billion in the first nine months of 2026.
summary:
Indian share markets are closed today, November 24, 2026, due to the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday.
In the last trading session on November 23, Sensex plunged 1,484 points and Nifty dropped below 25,400 in a severe sell-off.
Metal and bank stocks were worst hit, wiping out over ₹6 lakh crore of investor wealth, while IT stocks resisted the downturn.
